description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Shen''' primes his Spirit Blade, creating an area around it. After 2 seconds, or when '''Shen''' or an allied champion enters the area, the Spirit Blade generates a protective zone for 1.75 seconds, [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocking]] all non-[[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turret]] basic attacks that hit '''Shen''' or allied champions in the area.
description.text: Active: Shen primes his Spirit Blade, creating an area around it. After 2 seconds, or when Shen or an allied champion enters the area, the Spirit Blade generates a protective zone for 1.75 seconds, blocking all non- turret basic attacks that hit Shen or allied champions in the area.

notes.raw: * ''Spirit's Refuge's'' protective zone can be moved while active if '''Shen''' uses [[File:Shen Twilight Assault.png|20xpx|border|link=Shen#Twilight Assault|An icon for Shen's ability Twilight Assault]] [[Shen#Twilight Assault|Twilight Assault]]. * ''Spirit's Refuge'' cannot be ranked up at [[Experience (champion)|Level]] 1. * ''Spirit's Refuge'' will also block damage from all abilities that use [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]] ([[File:Fiora Lunge.png|20xpx|border|link=Fiora#Lunge|An icon for Fiora's ability Lunge]] [[Fiora#Lunge|Lunge]], [[File:Ezreal Mystic Shot.png|20xpx|border|link=Ezreal#Mystic Shot|An icon for Ezreal's ability Mystic Shot]] [[Ezreal#Mystic Shot|Mystic Shot]], [[File:Yasuo Steel Tempest.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Steel Tempest|An icon for Yasuo's ability Steel Tempest]] [[Yasuo#Steel Tempest|Steel Tempest]]). * Allied [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|clones]] are also considered champions for this ability.
notes.text:
Spirit's Refuge's protective zone can be moved while active if Shen uses Twilight Assault.
Spirit's Refuge cannot be ranked up at Level 1.
Spirit's Refuge will also block damage from all abilities that use basic damage ( Lunge, Mystic Shot, Steel Tempest).
Allied clones are also considered champions for this ability.
